categories.main_business_segments: Hankook Shell Oil Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing, blending, and sales of lubricants, greases, and related petroleum products. The company produces automotive, commercial vehicle, industrial, and marine lubricants, as well as greases, and provides technical services related to these products. It also engages in import and export of base oils, additives, and other blending materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced blending and manufacturing processes for lubricants and greases, including the use of high-efficiency synthetic base oils derived from natural gas (GTL) and synthetic oils. Production is carried out at its Yongdang plant in Busan, with a focus on quality control and adherence to international standards such as ISO 9001, ISO/TS 16949, and ISO 14001. The company emphasizes continuous technological support and product standardization aligned with Shell plc's global standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers, industrial machinery users, shipping companies, and other sectors requiring lubricants and greases. The company serves both domestic Korean markets and exports to foreign vessels and Southeast Asian markets through Shell Group's network. It targets premium segments such as high-end and imported vehicles and maintains partnerships with automotive service centers and organizations like the Korea Baseball Organization for brand promotion.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea, with manufacturing facilities in Busan and sales offices in Seoul and other regions. Export activities focus on Southeast Asia and supply to foreign-flagged vessels entering Korean ports. The company is part of the global Shell plc group, which operates in over 70 countries worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hankook Shell Oil operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the petroleum supply chain, focusing on lubricant and grease production, blending, and distribution. It sources base oils and additives both domestically and internationally and supplies finished products directly to end-users and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes development of high-performance, environmentally friendly lubricants, including synthetic and GTL-based products. It invests in upgrading production facilities to enhance capacity and efficiency. Sustainability and ESG initiatives are emphasized, including carbon and energy reduction investments. The company also focuses on maintaining premium product quality and expanding market share in high-end automotive segments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of manufactured lubricants and greases, both domestically and via exports. The company also earns income from trading lubricant-related products and providing technical services. Sales are conducted mainly on credit terms with established customers and distributors, supported by a structured credit management system.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a highly competitive domestic lubricant market characterized by oversupply and intense competition. It maintains a strong market position by leveraging the global Shell brand, premium product quality, and differentiated customer service. It is recognized as a leading lubricant manufacturer in Korea and part of Shell plc, the world's largest lubricant seller for 17 consecutive years.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported annual sales of approximately 320.5 billion KRW, with a 6.2% increase over the previous year and a net profit growth of 39.9%. Total assets stood at about 188.4 billion KRW, with a strong liquidity position and no debt. The company has maintained steady growth supported by premium product sales and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hankook Shell Oil emphasizes superior product quality, reliability, and advanced technology derived from Shell plc's global expertise. It offers high-performance, environmentally friendly lubricants tailored to diverse customer needs, supported by strong technical service and customer trust. The company differentiates itself through premium branding, consistent quality certifications, and a commitment to safety and environmental standards.
